missions-agency.geojson.caveats: HAND-BUILT APPROXIMATE POINTERS ONLY — no public source pins exact sites; do not treat any point as a surveyed location. Boutwell mission: described only as 'at Leech Lake', later associated with the Onigum south shore; pointer is the GNIS point for Onigum. Onigum village / Old Agency pointers carry small display-only offsets (~200-250 m) from the GNIS point so they do not stack; offsets are not surveyed locations. New Agency (1899): sources state only 'a peninsula about 2.5 miles across the water from the Old Agency' — the bearing/direction is NOT stated in the sources consulted, so the pointer was placed 2.5 mi west of the Old Agency pointer as a display placeholder; exact site unverified. Boarding schools: pointer-only at the community level (Walker, Cass Lake, Bena); no building footprints and no precise building locations. THPO/BAND: wording and placement owed — THPO/Band approval required before publishing; school features carry strictly factual fields only (name, operating dates, source) and no interpretive wording. All features carry location_precision='approximate' and thpo_required='yes'. Onigum coordinates cross-checked against GNIS (47.10944, -94.54472); Bena GNIS (47.34056, -94.20611); Walker GNIS (47.09972, -94.59778); all Onigum-area points verified on land against the DNR Leech Lake polygon (DOW 11020300).
missions-agency.geojson.query: Hand-built approximate pointers from published histories and the BIA Federal Indian Boarding School list (Apr 2022); no GIS service query — no public source pins exact sites.
